review:
BGaming's most famous character: a rock-and-roll frog performing on the Las Vegas strip. It's 5x3 with 25 lines, and Elvis himself is the wild.

The Coin Respin is the heart of it – land enough coins and they lock while you respin for more, chasing the Mini, Major and Mega jackpots. Scatters bring free spins, and you can gamble base-game wins on a card. Medium-high volatility, 2,500x max and free spins about once every 208 spins. RTP is 95.3%, lower than BGaming's newer games.
pros: Second route to big wins via respins or jackpots
Full game playable in the official free demo
cons: Short-session results can differ widely from the RTP
